scenes.line1: Which form method fits your app?
scenes.say: Angular has two ways to build forms. Which one should you use—reactive or template-driven?

scenes.label: Reactive
scenes.say: Reactive forms are model-driven. You create form controls in your TypeScript code.

scenes.label: Template
scenes.say: Template-driven forms rely on directives right in your HTML template.
Use reactive forms for complex validation or dynamic forms. Template-driven is best for simple cases.
Here’s a reactive form setup. You define controls in TypeScript for full flexibility.

scenes.question: Are template-driven forms better for all cases?
scenes.right: No, reactive forms are better for complex or dynamic needs.
scenes.say: Interviewers might ask if template-driven forms are always best. The answer is no—reactive forms are better for complex or dynamic needs.
